quarterly_data.signal: Dycom's fiscal 2027 second-quarter release gives the year-ago backlog comparison: total backlog of $12,242.4 million as of August 1, 2026 versus $7,989.2 million as of July 26, 2025 (+53.2%). Communications backlog was $10,983 million versus $7,989 million (+37.5%), with $5,362 million expected in the next 12 months versus $4,604 million; Building Systems had $1,110 million of backlog expected in the next 12 months. The Q2 2027 presentation shows a 1.4x organic book-to-bill for YTD 2027.
